title: EKS control plane Terraform adapter SDK + lifecycle probes
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: The existing private control plane provisioning Terraform modules are feature-rich but tightly coupled to internal provisioning scripts. This ticket proposes a thin Terraform adapter SDK layer that standardizes inputs/outputs, emits machine-readable lifecycle hooks, and wires in health and upgrade probes so downstream operators (Console, Provisioner, Ops runbooks) can reliably perform preflight validation, canary upgrades, and automatic rollbacks.

Goals:
- Create a stable Terraform module wrapper + small Go SDK (adapter) that: accepts a declarative control plane manifest, produces well-known outputs (cluster_id, controlplane_endpoint, kms_key_fingerprint, upgrade_state), and exposes lifecycle webhooks/events to an operator queue.
- Implement preflight validations (terraform validate + custom checks) and a fast plan/preview mode that reports drift risk and incompatible config.
- Add extensible lifecycle probes: pre-upgrade, post-upgrade, health-sanity, rollback-trigger. Probes must be idempotent and runnable independently by CI or by the provisioner operator.
- Ensure all state transitions are observable (metrics, logs, traces) and surfaced to Console rollout dashboards and Alerting.
- Provide clear compatibility matrix and fallbacks for older Terraform module consumers and air-gapped Private deployments.

Constraints & non-goals:
- This ticket does not replace the runtime control plane operator; it only standardizes the Terraform surface and lifecycle hook plumbing.
- We will not ship new cluster networking primitives in this module; it must integrate with existing priv-vpc modules.

Why this matters: Teams performing on-prem/VPC provisioning have been encountering brittle upgrades (silent drift during node pool changes, missing KMS targets, inconsistent cert rotation). Standardizing lifecycle hooks and adding preflight probes reduces upgrade blast radius and enables automatic rollback for common failure modes.
acceptance_criteria:
1) New terraform adapter SDK repo exists with example usage in priv-eks bootstrapping repo.
2) Module outputs standardized keys: cluster_id, controlplane_endpoint, kms_key_fingerprint, last_successful_upgrade_ts, upgrade_status.
3) Preflight validation step implemented and runnable locally/CI: terraform init/validate + custom checks; fails fast with actionable errors.
4) Lifecycle probe endpoints implemented as CLI subcommands (pre-upgrade, post-upgrade, health-check, rollback-check) and included in the module image.
5) Integration test that performs a canary upgrade: simulate a small control plane change, exercise probes, and verify automatic rollback on failing post-upgrade probe.
6) Metrics emitted to our telemetry endpoint and a sample Console dashboard shows rollout traces for the test cluster.
7) Documentation (README + runbook) and a templated GitHub Actions workflow provided.
tasks: Design adapter SDK interface and well-known terraform outputs
Prototype CLI-based lifecycle probes (go) and wire to module
Implement terraform module wrapper with improved input validation
Add preflight plugin that runs plan/diff heuristics and emits risk score
Create integration test harness (kind/mini-eks simulation or staging AWS account)
Add telemetry hooks and Console dashboard wiring (trace ids + rollout tags)
Write docs, runbook, and GitHub Actions example
Perform security review for KMS/key output exposure
